h: Defeated Brazilian presidential candidate Flavio Bolsonaro reportedly banned from leaving the country
p: Flavio Bolsonaro, who lost Brazil's presidential race, has reportedly been ordered to surrender his passports and not leave the country. The order comes after the election result in which Lula won.
more: Lula supporters have been celebrating his victory.
Bolsonaro's camp has yet to respond fully to the order.
